summary: A minimal GitHub Pages microsite for Rosetta's open-source Yrsa (Latin) and Rasa (Gujarati): a proof-sheet photo, a short intro with download links, two tall SVG specimen sheets themed on Indian performing arts, and teaser links to four process articles. The site's stylesheet did not load in the capture, so it renders as unstyled Times New Roman HTML around the images.

instances.look: Intended fixed navbar (div.navbar.fixed): 'Rosetta' logo link left, 'Website · GitHub · Contact' right; in the capture the CSS is missing so it shows as a plain link and bullet list in Times
Full-width photo of printed test sheets lying at an angle: huge bold Yrsa words ('adhesion', 'krasnoludek', 'hamburger') covered with green handwritten correction notes, arrows and redrawn letters
instances.ux: static image; no name or text over it
instances.learn: Open with annotated proofs: the corrections prove the craft and show the type at display size at the same time

reconstruction.layout: Image full container width (1424px at 8px body margin), ~900px tall, no overlay; page title 'Yrsa & Rasa' follows below
reconstruction.typography: Type only inside the photo (Yrsa Bold on paper); no live text
reconstruction.content: Real proof sheets with test words in Polish/Czech and English

instances.look: 'Yrsa & Rasa' heading and four short paragraphs: published by Rosetta with support from Google, 92 Latin languages + Gujarati and Kachchi, 5 weights; designed as a remix of Merriweather (Latin) and Skolar Gujarati; a row of three links (GitHub repo, Download the Yrsa fonts, Download the Rasa fonts)
instances.ux: Inline links to designers, source typefaces and the two release ZIPs on GitHub
instances.learn: Name the source typefaces openly ('a deliberate experiment in remixing existing typefaces'): for an open-source remix the lineage is the story

reconstruction.layout: Single text column under the photo, ~180px tall; links in one line at the end
reconstruction.typography: Intended site font unknown (CSS missing); captured as Times ~13px body and ~19px bold heading
reconstruction.content: Project facts, credits (Anna Giedryś, David Březina), sources (Merriweather by Eben Sorkin, Skolar Gujarati)

instances.look: Three plain underlined links at the end of the intro: 'Yrsa & Rasa GitHub repo', 'Download the Yrsa fonts', 'Download the Rasa fonts'
instances.ux: Direct links to v1.002 release ZIPs on GitHub
instances.learn: Separate download links per script family help users who only need one script

reconstruction.layout: Inline row of three links, space-separated
reconstruction.typography: Default link style (captured in Times ~13px, blue underlined)

instances.look: Two tall specimen sheets (SVG images) of rows separated by hairlines, alternating teal and black, mixing sizes and weights: 'Safflowers', a Bharata quote, '¿Qué está pasando?', a Lithuanian paragraph, 'Harmonious performance', 'Jedyne £64', 'Theater & Dance', two-column sonnet text, 'Süßholzraspeln', Polish, then Gujarati: 'શેરી નાટકો', 'હો રે છબીલા તારા', a bilingual two-column note on the Natya Shastra, ending with 'Tickets 156₹ | ટિકિટ ૧૫૬₹ | ટિકિટ 156₹'
instances.learn: Theme one specimen sheet around a subject that belongs to both scripts (Indian theatre and dance) and end with a mixed-script line (prices in Latin and Gujarati numerals): harmony between scripts is shown, not claimed

reconstruction.layout: Column ~940px wide, left-aligned; ~25 rows, each one line or a 2-column paragraph, separated by 1px light-grey rules with ~30px padding; sizes jump between rows (180px → 40px → 110px)
reconstruction.typography: Yrsa Light–Bold for Latin lines, Rasa Light–Bold for Gujarati; display rows ~100–180px, medium rows ~40–60px, paragraphs ~16px with bold run-in names; teal #6dbcb4 for alternate rows, black for the rest
reconstruction.content: Performing-arts theme in many Latin languages (Spanish, Lithuanian, Czech, German, Polish) and Gujarati; currency and numerals

instances.look: Grid of numbered article teasers in two columns (div.row > .span.six): '1. Introducing Yrsa', '2. Harmonizing Gujarati and Latin', '3. Yrsa & Rasa released', 'Language support', each a bold heading, one-line description and 'Read more' link
instances.ux: Each 'Read more' opens a sub-page article on the same site
instances.learn: Number the process articles so the microsite reads as a short serial about the making

reconstruction.typography: Captured unstyled: headings ~19px bold Times, descriptions ~13px, links blue
reconstruction.content: Project articles: intro, script harmonisation, release lessons ('redesigning someone else's work'), language support
